display.purpose: The name in the homepage hero, set wide. Used once.

headline.purpose: Page titles and the contact heading.

body.purpose: Reading text, kept to about 60 to 68ch.

readout.purpose: Values, dates, PR numbers and technology lists, condensed with tabular figures.

label.purpose: Labels beside a control or reading, navigation, keys and status words. Never a kicker above a heading.

motion.name: ease-detent
motion.purpose: The knob snapping to a detent and the finish switch sliding. Nothing else overshoots.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Everything else: key press, lamp warm-up, readout roll-in, trace draw-in, drawer.

motion.name: lamp-warm-up
motion.value: 420ms ease-out-expo on background and border colour
motion.purpose: Lamps warm up rather than switching on.

motion.name: trace-draw
motion.value: 520ms per segment, staggered 90ms, once on first view

motion.name: self-test
motion.value: pointer sweeps to the end of travel at 260ms, returns at 900ms, lamps warm at 1280ms; once per session
motion.purpose: The selector's power-on moment on the homepage.

narrative.overview: The site is a bench instrument in the Braun and Hewlett-Packard tradition: a bead-blasted aluminium plate with engraved legends, pilot lamps, one detented rotary selector and an inverted display window. Each project is a channel with a lamp, a reading taken from its own evidence, and a calibration date.
keyCharacteristics: Four greys and one amber pilot lamp, in a light aluminium finish and a black anodised finish.
One type family, Archivo, with its width axis doing the work a second face used to.
Depth from overlapping plates and seams only.
Selection by inversion: the selected thing becomes an ink plate.
Mechanical motion: detent snaps, lamps warming up, traces drawn in once.

rules.name: The One Lamp Rule
rules.body: Amber marks state or the single primary action, and nothing else.

rules.name: The Four Greys Rule
rules.body: No alpha fills, tints or extra greys. A surface is plate, seam, engraving or ink.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Archivo for everything. Hierarchy comes from size, width and case.

rules.name: The Legend Rule
rules.body: A legend labels a control or a reading. It never sits above a heading as a kicker.

rules.name: The No-Glow Rule
rules.body: No box-shadow, blur, backdrop-filter, glow or gradient, at any state.
